name: Ophir
line: Ophir was a faraway region famous for its fine gold, and Solomon's ships sailed there to bring back gold, precious stones, and special wood.

moments.title: Solomon's gold fleet
moments.text: Hiram sent skilled sailors to serve with Solomon's servants. They sailed to Ophir and brought back 420 talents of gold (a talent was a very heavy weight) to Solomon.

moments.title: Almug wood and gems
moments.text: Hiram's fleet brought a great cargo of almug wood and precious stones from Ophir, along with gold.

moments.title: More ships for Ophir gold
moments.text: Hiram sent ships with experienced sailors, who went with Solomon's servants to Ophir. They got 450 talents of gold there and brought it to King Solomon.
